title: Geometric slice stalk comparison for a single constant complex
statement: Let X be a scheme and B a commutative ring in universe t. Assume koszulConstantFunctor X B preserves zero morphisms, and choose any derived localization for ModuleCat.{t+1} B. Let R be a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet and phi : adicConstantRing X B -> R an isomorphism. Let W be an etale chart, Omega an algebraically closed field in universe t, and y : Spec Omega -> W.left. There exists a functor F from the unbounded derived category of modules on the actual R-ringed slice at W to the unbounded derived category of B-modules with carriers in universe t+1, such that for every algebraic B-cochain complex P, F applied to ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses of completedAdicDerivedChange(phi)(Q(finiteModelConstantComplex(P))) is isomorphic to Q of the termwise ModuleCat.uliftFunctor(P). This is a single-complex normalization and does not assert descent of derived morphisms or reflection of isomorphism classes.

proof.text: Construct scalarRestriction from modules over a sheafified constant ring to fixed-module-valued sheaves. Embed fixed-module presheaves fully faithfully into modules over the constant ring presheaf. Module sheafification along the locally bijective constant-section map gives full faithfulness and essential surjectivity of scalarRestriction. The sheafification unit of an already sheaf-valued object is invertible. Construct the inverse constantExtension and its scalarUnit, and identify its value on constant modules naturally. These are fully proved private helpers in FiniteConstantSliceStalkProof, following the scalar construction in FiniteCoefficientSliceModelTransport.

Apply the scalar construction on the actual R-ringed slice at W and compose with the pro-etale slice equivalence. The coefficient map phi is an isomorphism, so the constant-section map is locally bijective and sliceCoordinates is an equivalence. Its square with the ringed overFunctor is finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction. Reflect finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation through sliceCoordinates to prove exactness of overFunctor. The localization comparison and Q.objObjPreimageIso then give restrictionCoordinatesIso for the representative-based slice restriction.

Scalar restriction along phi is an equivalence: its composite with proEtaleModuleRestriction is the fixed-scalar restriction along the locally bijective constant-section map. Deriving this equivalence makes the unit of pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction invertible. Use that unit to cancel completedAdicDerivedChange against scalar restriction. The natural constantScalarIso and the continuous/cocontinuous chart-localization/sheafification comparison identify the result termwise with the constant sheaf of the lifted algebraic complex. Mapping through Q gives the fully proved private constantModelIso, for arbitrary B and arbitrary, possibly unbounded P.

Use the actual geometricPoint y constructed in ProEtaleFiniteModelStalks. Its fixed-module sheafFiber is additive and exact, by preservation of finite limits and finite colimits. Restriction from ULift B to B is the inverse of the scalar-restriction equivalence associated to ULift.ringEquiv; explicitly use its two adjoints. Compose the derived sliceCoordinates, sheafFiber, and scalar restriction to construct one functor F, independent of P.

Apply the two exact derived functors to restrictionCoordinatesIso followed by constantModelIso. The mapDerivedCategoryFactors isomorphisms compute their values on complexes. The natural Point.constantSheafCompSheafFiberIso identifies the point fibre of the entire constant complex, including differentials. Finally the unitIso of ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv cancels the two opposite scalar restrictions. Map these isomorphisms termwise and through Q, and compose. The construction works for the zero ring and imposes no bound on P.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteConstantSlice_derivedStalk_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{t + 1} B)]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ)
    (W : X.Etale) {Ω : Type t} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ W.left) :
    ∃ F : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1}
        (((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R).over
            ((toProEt X).obj W))) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t + 1} B),
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ,
        Nonempty (F.obj
          (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
            ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
            ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X φ).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B P)))) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
